claims.claim: Firefly Neural Architecture Descent expands neural network width or depth by searching a functional neighborhood around the current network.
The expansion uses a Taylor-based greedy selection rule to choose growth operations.
The method targets accurate and resource-efficient models and is applicable to continual learning.
Firefly descent is described as a general approach for growing neural networks.
